## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Barcelona, Spain. It starts at Carrer de la Barra de Ferro 5.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> A perfect activity for friends, family, and art lovers of all ages, the MEAM lets visitors discover a type of contemporary art that's difficult to find in other museums.
>
> Located in El Born, wander through the historic streets in the center of Barcelona and discover this artistic oasis where you can recharge yourself and see some spectacular works of art.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €15.31. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 88 ratings and 52 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
